text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio makes it a routine to watch replays of Mejiro McQueen's races before training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she still can't grasp what it is that makes McQueen so different.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having reached a conclusion myself, I explain what I believe she lacks: the will to crawl her way back up from rock bottom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This realization hits Teio hard. However, she knows she needs to face the facts if she's going to get stronger and work towards her goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio accepts that she lost against Mejiro McQueen. She uses that frustration as a springboard to grow even further.
